propositions: Configuration and security documentation must be generated from authoritative registries (config schema, deprecation lifecycle, secret names) to stay byte-current rather than drifting by hand

A new generator script must produce docs/config-reference.md and docs/security.md whole while leaving docs/config.md byte-unchanged to preserve all existing consumers (content-asserting tests and deep-linked anchors)
Generated docs must carry self-announcing banners naming the generator command and be registered in the parity gate (GENERATED map and README table) so they are recognized and drift-checked
A --check mode must detect and fail when either generated doc becomes stale, with newline-normalized comparison to avoid false failures on CRLF checkouts

All required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) must have anchors in the generated docs, verified by test
The generator and drift gate must run portably under make test with no CI provider required
